title: UN Commission finding on policy to destroy Gaza health care
summary: The Commission made a focused finding concerning the destruction of Gaza's health-care system and treatment of medical personnel.
claim: The Commission found that Israel implemented a concerted policy to destroy Gaza's health-care system and that Israeli security forces deliberately killed, wounded, detained, mistreated and tortured medical personnel and targeted medical vehicles.
legal_characterization: UN Commission finding that included war-crime and crime-against-humanity characterizations; not a judicial judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against paragraph 89 of A/79/232. The record attributes the policy and legal characterizations to the Commission and does not present them as findings of a court or as individual criminal convictions.
